paragraphs.text:
You race for the cover of the deep woods. The monster follows, 
and it is catching up. The Big Woods are home to its kind. Your 
only hope is to bury yourself beneath the canopy.
Make a Stealth roll: if you succeed, go to 336; if not, go to 337.
